title: Understand the y-Intercept Core Test
description: Interpret the y-intercept as the starting value and the point where a line crosses the y-axis.

questions.questionText: A line crosses the y-axis at (0, 3). What is the y-intercept?
questions.explanation: The y-intercept is the y-value where x = 0. In y = mx + b, it is b.

questions.questionText: In the equation y = 3/2x - 2, what is the y-intercept?
